channel.title: Open Sans Typeface Specimen
channel.description: Open Sans is an open-source humanist sans-serif typeface designed by Steve Matteson for Google Fonts, featuring 10 weights and upright and italic styles.

item.title: Open Sans Typeface Specimen (Latin)
item.description: Explore all 10 weights and styles of the Open Sans humanist sans-serif typeface by Steve Matteson.

item.title: Open Sans Hebrew Typeface Specimen
item.description: Explore Open Sans Hebrew designed by Yanek Iontef as an extension of Steve Matteson's Open Sans typeface.
